summary: All 9 requested flows on the new per-player finishing-order UI PASSED. Live tab -> match-card-482913 opens Match Control screen; each player row exposes rank-{color}-{pos} buttons for pos 1..nop (4); uniqueness rule enforced (assigning a position to another color auto-removes it from the previous owner); APPLY writes exact map {red:1,blue:2,yellow:3,green:4} to matches/482913/control/ranks; toggle-off removes that color from ranks; force-dice-green-5 toggles the value between 5 and 0; CLEAR wipes the entire control node (verified null via Firebase REST); MANIPULATION ACTIVE badge appears on the Live card while control is set and disappears after clear. Match #482913 left in original state (status=live, control=null) as required. No React Native red screen, no console errors (only benign 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warning from a third-party lib, not from app code).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: match/[id].tsx has leftover unused styles (rankLabel, chipRow, rankChip, chipText) from the removed rank1/rank2 chips implementation - safe to delete for cleanliness.
Minor: showToast uses setTimeout without cleanup on unmount - low risk but could log a state-update-on-unmounted warning if the user navigates back within 2.4s of toasting.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeded match 482913 was used; control node cleaned before and after tests. Match left live with control removed.
